hero.title: John Cornyn Faces Tough Challenge From Trump-Backed Ken Paxton in Texas GOP Runoff
hero.intro: Texas Republicans head into a high-profile Senate runoff between John Cornyn and Trump-backed Ken Paxton in a race with major national implications for the GOP.
hero.author: Emily Rodriguez
hero.contentLeft: The runoff has become a defining test of Donald Trump's influence inside the Republican Party.
hero.contentRight:
Cornyn and Paxton are fighting over MAGA loyalty, electability and the future direction of Texas Republican politics.

Democrats see the bruising primary as a possible opening in November.

hero.title: Traditional Music in the Heart of Globalized World
hero.intro: In an increasingly connected world, traditional music faces both challenges and opportunities.
hero.author: Maxin Dalton
hero.contentLeft: Globalization can lead to the homogenization of sound, but also provides new platforms for regional artists.
hero.contentRight:
New digital archives are preserving ancient melodies for the 2020s generation.

Music festivals are seeing a revival of ethnic genres.
